an4.123:1.6: We have learned that the lifespan of the highest sense-sphere realm is 9,216,000,000 human years ([an3.70:34.4]()).  that the duration of each ascending realm increases fourfold, it suggests that the next realm, namely the first Brahmā realm, is 36.864 billion years. In [vb18:191.3]() the lifespan of Mahābrahma, from the full development of the first absorption, is one eon. See [mn83:11.4]() and note there.
